title: The rules of Tayammum
intro: When there is no water, we purify ourselves by touching clean earth.

learn.html: Tayammum is touching earth, or something made of earth, for a symbolic purification. We do it:

items: when we want to pray or recite the Qur’an and have no water for wudu or ghusl
when we have only a little water that we need for drinking and cooking
when we can’t use the water – because it is dirty, because of illness, great cold and so on

items.label: 1. The niyyah in the heart, with A‘udhu billah and Bismillah
2. Touch dry earth with the palms and wipe the face once
3. Touch the earth again and wipe the right and left arm past the elbows

learn.label: The niyyah of tayammum
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ التَّيَمُّمَ لِأَجْلِ الصَّلَاةِ وَلِرَفْعِ الْحَدَثِ تَقَرُّبًا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
learn.tr: Nawaytut-tayammuma li-ajlis-salaati wa li-raf‘il-hadathi taqarruban ilallaahi ta‘aalaa.
learn.en: I intend to make tayammum for Salah, to remove impurity and to come closer to Allah, the Most High.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Tayammum is broken by everything that breaks wudu – and when we are able to use water for wudu or ghusl again.

practice.title: When do we make tayammum?
practice.prompt: Tap the right times, then tap Check.

options.text: We need the little water for drinking
We are ill and can’t use water

options.why: If we can use water, we must make wudu.

questions.q: How many times do we wipe the face?

options: Whatever breaks wudu, and finding usable water

practice.title: Questions to talk about
prompts: 💬 What is tayammum? When do we make it?
💬 What are the three fard of tayammum? What breaks it?
